summary: Backend API testing complete for Allapotkod (Hungarian state-code AI chat) app. Created pytest suite covering config, auth gating, code verify/me/reset, admin CRUD, and live Gemini chat. 25/25 tests passed including a real Gemini 3.1-pro call via emergentintegrations.

minor.issue: Stale comment block inside the `if r.status_code != 200` branch is misleading — it reads like a fallback path but actually unconditionally raises 401. Cosmetic only.

Replays prior USER messages into LlmChat without the matching assistant turns; this re-asks past questions and can cause duplicate model output / extra token spend. Consider passing both roles or relying on persistent session memory.

action_items: (Optional) Tidy misleading comment block inside /api/auth/session error branch.
(Optional) Fix chat history replay logic in /api/chat/send to avoid replaying only user-side messages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~417 lines, well organised; OK to keep single-file for now.
ObjectId is correctly excluded via {'_id': 0} projections — good.
First-user-becomes-admin logic depends on `count_documents({}) == 0` BEFORE insert — correct order.
Code verification correctly resets chat history on (re)setting a code — matches PRD.
Bearer token auth uses indexed MongoDB collection with TTL index on expires_at — clean.
Frontend env key used is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as system prompt states); already correct in code per Expo public env convention.
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral users + sessions injected directly into MongoDB (users, user_sessions) prefixed with TEST_; cleaned up in fixture teardown. Demo state_codes (1234/5678/9012/4321) were auto-seeded by the app on first startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/ pytest suite as regression. To run: `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest . -v`. Tests inject fake sessions into Mongo to bypass Emergent OAuth. Real Gemini call in TestChat::test_chat_send_and_history hits EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and takes ~10s. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 25 backend tests passed including the live LLM round-trip.
